homeReview.scope: Current Home review after increasing only both right tile widths; Play mode-label review is separate.
homeReview.assessmentType: Independent subjective comparison of the supplied Home layout reference, actual supplied image subjects, and final actual-GLB browser captures. Not a pixel-match score or a claim that unavailable destination systems are implemented.

reference.notes: Tall-left/stacked-right reference hierarchy retained. Latest authorized width change deliberately makes each right tile wider than the reference; no reference characters or placeholder copy imported.

rubric.notes: Tall left tile and equal stacked right tiles retain the reference hierarchy. Latest requested right widths are 358px rather than 298px at 1280, with left size, outer heights, gaps and positions unchanged. Wider right stack remains balanced with the existing creature.

rubric.category: Actual supplied artwork and useful framing
rubric.notes: Actual portrait king/throne, full map and sorcerer/portal remain recognizable. Herald Board gains useful horizontal context from the wider cover area. Chronicles keeps the same height-constrained complete map, so wider sidebars are expected under unchanged contain framing. No image regeneration or focal-policy adjustment.

rubric.category: Titles, readability and honest destination states
rubric.notes: Only the three supplied titles appear on the tiles. No invented stats, lore or news are added. Each activation opens a clearly unavailable informational dialog with Back to Home; no unsupported launch action is offered. Compact bold gray/amber headings fit all reviewed viewports.

The approved actual sorcerer, scale, upward framing, pose and magical atmosphere remain. The new three-tile grid balances the exposed character silhouette; supplied portrait, map and portal art have distinct but compatible fantasy palettes.

All three actual-GLB captures keep every tile visible, aligned and free of page overflow. Phone-landscape map text is very small, but the map is a menu illustration rather than a readable interactive atlas.

artwork.sourceInspection: All three original JPEGs independently viewed before reviewing browser composites. Optimized web copies use actual supplied pixels rather than generated replacements.

framing.My Legacy: Centered cover; king and throne retained.
framing.Chronicles: Contain; complete source map retained at the 215px card height, with approximately 35px sidebars per side in the 358px-wide 1280 design tile.
framing.Herald Board: Centered cover; wider tile reveals more horizontal portal/sorcerer scene context.

evidence.notes: Critic independently inspected source artwork, all three Home renders and unavailable-state source wording. Keyboard/controller/pointer focus and geometry assertions are supported by the separate passing Home verification artifact.

iterationHistory.findings: Reference geometry and distinct supplied sources read well. Full map context retained; small embedded label overlap judged acceptable. No visual crop or title-position change requested.

All titles, complete tile grid, actual supplied image subjects and existing creature are clear. Root corrected a focus-restoration ordering issue; Home verification now passes. No blocking visual issue.

Right tiles increased 298→358px, left and stacked heights/gaps unchanged. All titles fit at desktop and landscape sizes; creature face/crown stay clear. Chronicles full-map sidebars widen by design; Herald Board shows more scene context. No further adjustment requested.

limits: The map's baked-in labels are small and one partially shares the Chronicles heading area; the tile preserves full map context rather than serving as a readable atlas.

homeReview.verdict: Retains the subjective 9.2/10 Home assessment after the requested wider right tiles. No blocking balance, title-fit or creature-clearance issue identified.

creatureTransform.method: Only an additive parent world-Y anchor is raised; existing ambient Y sway remains additive. Scale, model center, approved yaw/lean, rig, all four arm poses, Idle clip, materials, cards and artwork are unchanged.

creatureIdleFramingEvidence.method: Actual decoded/skinned GLB vertex projections from authored Idle key times and midpoints, combined with independent ambient Y/yaw extrema. Geometric rest-space crown/face/eye proxy regions calibrated by screenshot overlay. No product debug edits.
creatureIdleFramingEvidence.interpretation: All sampled crown, face-proxy and eye-proxy clearances are positive across the reviewed aspects. Sampled worst desktop images also visually retain the crown and visible eye above the cards.
creatureIdleFramingEvidence.limits: Dense sampled geometric evidence, not a continuous mathematical guarantee or semantic face/ring detector. Applies to the menu Idle clip and tested ambient extrema.
